name: application-breadcrumbs
title: Breadcrumbs
description: Responsive breadcrumb navigation components for tracking location within websites and applications. Perfect for ecommerce, dashboards, and multi-level navigation with customizable dividers and icons.
useWhen: Responsive breadcrumb navigation components for tracking location within websites and applications. Perfect for ecommerce, dashboards, and multi-level navigation with customizable dividers and icons.
avoidWhen: Avoid breadcrumbs when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Breadcrumbs uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
